sources.title: Tunisia: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For stays of up to three months for tourism, business or visiting acquaintances, a visa is not required.

sources.title: Panama: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Japanese nationals entering Panama for tourism do not need a visa or tourist card and may stay visa-free for up to 90 days.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: By a Bosnia and Herzegovina government measure, a visa is not required for total stays of up to 90 days in six months.

sources.title: Kosovo: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Although Japan has no visa-exemption agreement with Kosovo, Japanese nationals are exempt from a visa; over-90-day stays need a special permit.

sources.title: Cuba: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: From 1 July 2025, the electronic visa is Cuba's only valid entry instrument; apply through the official eVisa site.

sources.title: Djibouti: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A purpose-appropriate visa is always required and must be applied for and obtained in advance through a Djibouti embassy or the E-VISA application website.

sources.title: Comoros: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Travellers entering directly from a country such as Japan without a Comoros overseas mission can obtain a visa at the arrival airport.

sources.title: Côte d’Ivoire: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Complete the online E-VISA application and payment, print the authorization, and obtain the visa at the visa counter in Abidjan airport.

sources.title: Guinea-Bissau: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa is required regardless of entry purpose; it generally cannot be obtained after arrival and must be obtained before arrival.

sources.title: Cambodia: Overseas Safety Basic Data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan MOFA's Overseas Safety page publishes destination entry information for Japanese nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Cambodian visas can be obtained at major airports and land borders on entry; tourist and business e-Visas are also available from the Foreign Ministry website.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: specified visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Japan MOFA guidance expressly records visa-free short-visitor access for the listed Japanese ordinary-passport destinations.
conditions: TN: tourism, business or visiting-acquaintance stays up to three months. PA: tourism up to 90 days, with passport, onward transport and funds requirements.
BA: aggregate stays up to 90 days in six months. XK: visa-exempt; a special permit is required after 90 days. This does not classify work, residence, special documents or final admission.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Cuba electronic visa
policies.summary: Japan MOFA says Cuba's electronic visa is the only valid entry instrument and links the official application service.
conditions: Apply through Cuba's official eVisa service before travel. Purpose, passport, health, entry-form and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: expressly available arrival-issued visitor visas
policies.summary: Japan MOFA expressly describes border issuance for the listed Japanese ordinary-passport routes.
conditions: KM: arrival-airport issuance is available to direct arrivals from Japan and other countries without a Comoros overseas mission.
CI: online application and payment yield an authorization; the visa itself is obtained at Abidjan airport, so it is classified as visa on arrival rather than eVisa.
KH: visas are available on arrival at major airports and land borders. Cambodia also provides an eVisa route, but the expressly stated arrival route is the status recorded.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: specified advance visitor visas
policies.summary: Japan MOFA expressly requires the listed visas to be obtained before entry or arrival.
conditions: DJ: obtain the purpose-appropriate visa before entry through an embassy or the named online application site; online application does not by itself prove electronic issuance.
GW: a visa is required regardless of entry purpose and must be obtained before arrival; yellow-fever and final-admission requirements remain applicable.

conflicts.explanation: Japan MOFA requires obtaining the visa before entry through a mission or online application site, but does not establish electronic issuance.
Japan MOFA says the online authorization is printed and the visa is obtained at Abidjan airport, so issuance is on arrival.
Japan MOFA expressly says a Guinea-Bissau visa cannot generally be obtained after arrival and must be obtained before arrival.
